text:
karen: Heads-up: new Dedicated RTX6000-Ada pools are available in us-east-2b and eu-central-1b as of today. Pools: `dedicated-rtx6000-us-east-2b`, `dedicated-rtx6000-eu-central-1b`.

karen: Initial capacity: us-east-2b = 40 cards, eu-central-1b = 20 cards. These targets are for mid-range production inference (good balance of cost and single-stream latency for 4k-12k contexts).

josh: Any special reservation or commerce changes?

karen: Two items: 1) new soft-hold for shipments coming from our provider — new pools open in staged mode for 24h while hardware health checks complete; 2) policy: default cross-tenant burst = 20% but subject to a per-tenant daily burst budget to avoid flash contention. Reserved capacity and enterprise commitments unchanged.

josh: How should we position vs H100 and A10G?

karen: Quick positioning: RTX6000-Ada sits between A10G and H100: better latency than A10G for single-stream workloads, cheaper than H100 for most int8 paths. Recommend RTX6000 for mid-latency SLAs and cost-aware production. H100 for extreme low p99; A10G for lowest-cost batch/embeddings.

sales-ops: Need a short blurb + pricing delta for AE kit.

karen: I'll drop a 2-paragraph blurb and delta by 3pm. Include the caveat about staged-open period.

sre-bot: Autoscaler applied: min_replicas=2, scale_step=4, cooldown=140s. Health-checks: 24h staged mode, alert if GPU ECC errors > 0 on any new card.

legal: Any compliance flags for eu pools?

karen: eu-central runs with the standard Private data path and KMS integration. No additional controls required but ops should validate customer KMS bindings for Private customers.

karen: Reservation CLI example:
```
# reserve 3 cards for 30d in us-east-2b
rw-cli dedicated reserve --pool dedicated-rtx6000-us-east-2b --count 3 --duration 30d --burst-budget=default
```

josh: Routing note: pools added with region_affinity=preferred and cost_tier=mid. No automatic migration of reservations. Global routing will prefer local pools first.

karen: TL;DR: RTX6000-Ada Dedicated pools live in us-east-2b & eu-central-1b, staged 24h health window, default burst controls with daily budgets, reservations unaffected. Post-launch watch 48h; I'll share utilization snapshot afterwards. Ping me or @sre if you need early-access reservations.
